info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Borate Jacket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Borate Jacket Detail Management API facilitates the creation and management of detailed records for borate jacket products. This API allows users to submit new catalog entries, ensuring accurate representation of product specifications and features. Ideal for product managers and inventory systems, it supports integration with e-commerce and retail applications. Developers can leverage this API to streamline catalog updates and enhance product visibility across platforms.

post.summary: Creates a new set of details for a borate jacket.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create detailed information related to a borate jacket. The details provided will be used for further processing and storage, ensuring that all necessary data attributes are captured for effective jacket management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit detailed information regarding the borate jacket. It must adhere to the structure defined in the associated schema and includes essential data for processing the request.

200.description: The request completed successfully and the details were retrieved.

CreateCatalogBorateJacketDetailRequest.title: Borate Jacket Order Request

borate_jacket_id.description: The unique identifier for the borate jacket being requested.

requestedBy.description: The name of the individual or entity requesting the borate jacket.

quantity.description: The number of borate jackets requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of a single borate jacket.

CreateCatalogBorateJacketDetailRequest.description: Schema representing a request to order borate jackets, including details such as identifier, quantity, and pricing information.

CreateCatalogBorateJacketDetailResponse_.title: Borate Jacket Operation Response

status.description: The status of the operation, indicating success or failure.

recordId.description: The identifier of the record that was processed.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when the processing occurred.

matchedCount.description: The number of records matched during the operation.

CreateCatalogBorateJacketDetailResponse_.description: Response schema for the Borate Jacket details operation performed via POST.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the resource returned by the server. This tells the client what the payload format of the returned data is.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. This can help in measuring the performance of the API.
